text: The Shao-Tien clan is a clan of mogu that operate mainly in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, fielding an entire army in their quest for dominance. Some of them were later captured by the True Horde and taken to Orgrimmar, where they were incarcerated in the Underhold.
Shao-Li Ironbelly is a pandaren found in an inn in Mandori Village on the Wandering Isle. She is the drinking Champion.

Shan'ze Gravekeepers are mogu of the Shan'ze clan located in the Court of Bones on the Isle of Thunder. Grand Magister Rommath of the Horde and Narasi Snowdawn of the Alliance want them eliminated in order for their respective factions to gain foothold on the strategic position that the Mogu currently roam.
Shan'ze Thundercallers are mogu located at the Court of Bones on the Isle of Thunder. They are seen raising Risen Ancestors.
Shan'ze Soulrippers are mogu located at the Court of Bones on the Isle of Thunder.
Shan'ze Bloodseekers are mogu located in Diremoor on the Isle of Thunder.
Shan'ze Electrocutioner is a mogu located on the Isle of Thunder.
Shan'ze Slavers are mogu located in the Lightning Vein Mine on the Isle of Thunder. They are accompanied by Saurok Slaves.
Shan'ze Animators are mogu located in Diremoor on the Isle of Thunder. They are seen animating Animated Warriors.
Shan'ze Ritual Stones are used to summon one of nine summonable bosses on the Isle of Thunder. These bosses are designed for a group.
Shaol'mara Beastcallers are Zandalari trolls located in Shaol'mara on the Isle of Thunder. They are accompanied by two Shaol'mara Raptors.
Shaol'mara Raptors are located in Shaol'mara on the Isle of Thunder. They are the pets of Shaol'mara Beastcallers.
Shan-xi Watershapers are jinyu found in the Hall of Shapers in Mogu'shan Vaults.
Shale Stalkers are shale spiders located in the Forgotten Depths of the Throne of Thunder.
Shao-Tien Rice bags are found in northwestern Vale of Eternal Blossoms. They contain Fresh Shao-Tien Rice.
Shaping of the World is the sheet music for the song "Shaping of the World".

Shanna Sparkfizz is a goblin found in the Siegeworks during the Siege of Orgrimmar. She's Helix Blackfuse's assistant. Upon her demise, Shanna exploded. Blackfuse then commented he was now in the market for a new assistant.
Shappu the Wise is a pandaren located in the Krasarang Wilds.
Shard of the Defiler is unobtainable and equipping it turns the player's model into a vanilla red-variant nathrezim model due to the spell known as .
__NOTOC__ The Shard of Supremus summons an abyssal named Abyssius. This item drops from Supremus in the Black Temple.
The Shard of Cyrukh can be looted from the Forgotten Shard of the Cipher in the Corrupted Refuge after completing The Cipher of Damnation (Tanaan Jungle).

Shaladrassil is a World Tree situated in northern Val'sharah that was once responsible for protecting the land, but it was corrupted by the Emerald Nightmare during the Burning Legion's third invasion of Azeroth. The ruined town of Shala'nir was built around it. The Emerald Nightmare raid can be entered through the base of the tree, and Darkheart Thicket, which is underneath it, can be entered from a nearby cave. Inside the raid, the Clutch of Corruption occupies the trunk, while the proper Emerald Nightmare can be entered through the Core of the Nightmare located simultaneously atop the tree and inside the Nightmare itself.
Shambling Hulks are orcs located in Hellfire Antechamber in .
__NOTOC__ Shao'ghun is a felguard located at Grommash's Torment in . He's playing golf with draenei prisoners, assisted with Bryanda.
Shard of Tectus is an earth fury located at the Market District in Highmaul. For most of the fight, Tectus is split into these.

Sharas'dal, Scepter of Tides is the artifact weapon for Restoration shaman in World of Warcraft: Legion. Equipping it will automatically place the Shield of the Sea Queen in your off hand. An illusion of the scepter was used by the naga as bait for a trap in Nazjatar to draw the Alliance and Horde in range of the Blackwater Behemoth.

Shappa is a tauren follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. He can be recruited from the Frostwall Tavern building via Akanja. Prior to the Battle for the Broken Shore, like many other followers, he appears at the Dranosh'ar Blockade at the sparring ring, where champions duel in preparation for the assault on the Broken Shore.

Shal'dorei Silk, as its name suggests, is created by the nightborne, using the same pattern weave that the Highborne used, not surprising since many nightborne were Highborne from before the Great Sundering. This silk is sumptuous and is created with a bit of ley energy woven right into it. At first glance, it can be mistaken for old festival cloth that was made by the night elves. The ley energy within causes the silk to be 'fickle' about the types of thread they'll accept. Normal thread apparently will burn, falling out of the cloth and leaving the material ripped and snagged. The solution to this is to use something that's learned to coexist with the ley energies of the Broken Isles, and

Shannon Noel can be found in the Chamber of the Guardian in Dalaran. She organizes the books inside the Chamber of the Guardian. She used to take all the books down and put them back up, but the Kirin Tor got annoyed the last few times she did that. She is also a writer and makes things with her imagination. She demonstrated her talent by creating an Ethereal Sunrunner in front of the player.
Shapemender was a Feral and Guardian druid honor talent, available at rank 4.
Shards of Hate are infernals appearing during Vol'jin's funeral after the battle for the Broken Shore.

Shard is one of the three small earth elemental guardians created by Navarrogg. Players are initially sent to rescue Shard, along with Frag and Gravel, during Pet Rocks. Upon recovering Shard, Torok Bloodtotem will yell the following message: : After being rescued, Shard and Gravel join Navarrogg at his refuge, and later assist their master in combat against the Bloodtotem tribe. :
Shard of Darkness is part of the process to obtain Heart of Corruption. Speak to Lord Maxwell Tyrosus while in possession of the shard to start Walking in Shadows.
Shaman's Pouch can be found on Dead Frostpaw Shaman in Grizzlemaw in Grizzly Hills, during Fallen Offerings.
Sharazaan is an eredar warlock. He had an imp named Daglop who betrayed him, summoned him in Gloombound Barrow of Azsuna and with the help of his minion, the class order leader defeated the demon.
Shandris's Fingerless Gloves drops from mobs in the Broken Isles.
Shal'dorei Terrace (or Shal'Dorei Terrace) is the garden of the Nighthold that High Botanist Tel'arn is fought in.
Shan'ze Deathspeaker is a mogu necromancer located on the isle of Shan'ze Dao in Townlong Steppes.
__NOTOC__ Shalas'aman is a night elf located at Tangled Cleft in Val'sharah.

__NOTOC__ Shala'nir is a druid grove located amidst the roots of the world tree Shaladrassil. It used to be a tranquil enclave, and contained a village as well as an inn. The ancient Ironbranch resides deep in the overrun grove, and other nightmarish creatures flock to him. The grove was eventually overrun by satyr led by Banehoof and corrupted by the Emerald Nightmare. It became one of Xavius's main strongholds, and he pretended to hold Malfurion Stormrage here. The village holds the entrance to both Darkheart Thicket and the Emerald Nightmare. The Dreamweavers work to cleanse the corruption.
Disgruntled Servant is a nightborne located at Midnight Court in Suramar.

Shang Xi's Hot Air Balloon is Master Shang Xi's hot air balloon. While first located in Morning Breeze Village on the Wandering Isle, it is later encountered at the Wood of Staves, being used by Shang Xi's students to talk to Shen-zin Su. Finally, they used the balloon to travel out of the Wandering Isle.
Shaman Survivors are orcs located inTanaan Jungle. They accompany .
Shan'ze Ancestors are mogu ghosts located on Shan'ze Dao in Townlong Steppes. They corrupt souls.
Shan'ze Warriors are mogu located on the Isle of Thunder during The Fall of Shan Bu.
Shan'ze Battlemasters are mogu located on the Isle of Thunder appearing during The Fall of Shan Bu.
Shani Edwards is a Game Producer for Blizzard Entertainment's World of Warcraft. She works with the character artists, riggers, and animators.
Shalassian is the language of the nightborne. It is an offshoot of Darnassian, similar to Thalassian. Ancient nightborne language is so archaic only the oldest elves might be able to read it.
Shard of Twisting Nether can be found in the Champion Equipment or from continued reputation caches.
Shambling Hungerers are withered located in the Arcing Depths in the Nighthold.

The Shalassi arakkoa inhabit Veil Shalas in Terokkar Forest.

Shanky Ralla is a Zandalari child found overlooking the Mugambala in Zuldazar. She is riding upon the back of Bucktooth Busta and sitting next to Knotty Fred. Duelin' Dinzo is running around behind them.
Shala'nir Druids are deceased night elves located in Shala'nir in Val'sharah.
Shalo is a tortollan located in Little Tortolla in Dazar'alor.
Shamanistic Healing is an Elemental shaman artifact trait. It is linked to the Lava Imbued, Master of the Elements (shaman artifact trait), Molten Blast, and Static Overload traits.
The Shard of Kaldorei Stained Glass drops from Mephistroth in the Cathedral of Eternal Night.
Shambling Berserker's Leggings drop from Vol'kaal in Atal'Dazar.
The Shalebiter Interlinked Chain drops from Azerokk in the MOTHERLODE!!
The Shaladrassil Chestguard is a quest reward from The Tears of Elune.
Shambling Assistants are zombies located in the Twilight Highlands.
Shambling Skeletons are skeletal trolls summoned by the Guardian of the Tombs in Zanchul in Dazar'alor.
__NOTOC__ Shambling Bilestitches are Forsaken abominations located on the Mangrove Shore in Nazmir while the Faction Assault on Nazmir world quest Barreling Through is available.

The Shards of Corruption can be found along Vir'naal River in Uldum during an Assault in Uldum, once an Aether of the Abyss has been absorbed.

Shanty Raid is an exploration achievement earned by finding the Forbidden Sea Shanties of Tiragarde Sound.
Shard-Tipped Vambraces drop from the Adderis and Aspix encounter in the Temple of Sethraliss.
Shards of Halkias are sinstone golems located in the Halls of Atonement. They each carry a part of the anima of Halkias. Once all are defeated, the sin-stained goliath can be fought.
Shaping Gargon are gargon located at Wanecrypt Hill in Revendreth. Wanecrypt Stoneshapers are found working on them.
Shao-Tien Wraiths are mogu ghosts located in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Shao-Tien Spirit Warriors are mogu ghosts located in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

Shard Labor is an exploration achievement earned by finding all 50 of the lost anima crystal shards in Bastion, the Necrotic Wake, and Spires of Ascension. Upon completion, head to Forgelite Hephaesius at the Seat of Eternal Hymns in Bastion and speak with her to have her craft the Crystal Mallet of Heralds. : : : Take the mallet to the Vesper of Silver Winds at at the Shrine of the Silver Wind in Bastion, and use it on the vesper: : A Silverwind Larion will descend from on high, placing the Gift of the Silver Wind chest on the ground. Open it to obtain the Silverwind Larion mount.
__NOTOC__ Shan'ala, Lost to the Tangle is a large veilwing located in Mistveil Tangle in Ardenweald.
Shanir Veinccutter is a Maldraxxi gladiator located at the Theater of Pain in Maldraxxus.
Shan is a sylvar located at the Heart of the Forest in Ardenweald.
Shards of the Countess drop from Duchess Minodora in Revendreth.
Shambling Deadeyes are Forsaken attacking Bashal'Aran and present in Ashwood Depot in Darkshore during In Darkest Night. They are killed by Tyrande Whisperwind.
Shale beasts are a category of beast-like earth elementals, consisting of gyreworms and shale spiders.
Shard-Covered Dreadcloak can be purchased from Dawn-Seeker Verroak in Stormshield or Dawn-Seeker Jiklar in Warspear for .
Shar'nir is a sylvar located at the Hibernal Hollow in Ardenweald.
Shamet is a Maldraxxi skeleton located in the House of the Chosen in Maldraxxus.

Shaping Fate is the weekly high-level task objective for Korthia and the Maw. Players are nudged to complete one or both Covenant assaults each week, alongside some Tormentors of Torghast events, and daily quests in Korthia. Shaldorei Silk Filter is used by Deucus Valdera on his alchemy table in the Agronomical Apothecary in Dalaran. It was originally torn, but later mended by Leyweaver Erenyi.

Shard of Zed drops from the bosses in the Sanctum of Domination.
Shard of Oth drops from the bosses in the Sanctum of Domination.

Shaman-tank or sometimes referred to as "Warden" is the playstyle of adopting the traits of the tank role in Classic Era and Burning Crusade Classic as a Shaman. Initially, the Shaman was not designed to fulfill the tank role during its original inception, but over the years, the Shaman as a tank has improved through research and effort from the community to legitimize their role as an unofficial tank. Shaman, although, not the most optimal class to be played as a tank is still deemed to be a viable option. Shard of Entropys are crystals summoned by Vorath in Deatholme in the Ghostlands during Justice Long Overdue.
Shard of Frozen Secrets is a cosmetic dagger available for purchase for 200 Trader's Tender at the Trading Post. It was first available in February 2023.

Shaping the Dreamsurge is the weekly wrapper quest for the Dreamsurge event added in patch 10.1.7. Find Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem in the active zone to start the quest.

Shang Xi Rations would presumably be obtained at Shang Xi Training Grounds on the Wandering Isle.

Shandris's Mission Journal is a tome found behind a wagon in the Haven Cascades in the Emerald Dream during Under the Surface.
Shan'ze Spiritbinders are mogu located in the Terrace of Ten Thunders in the Jade Forest. They summon Shan'ze Spirit Apparitions.
__NOTOC__ Sharp Claws can be looted from most level 9-32 beast, and humanoid monsters.

Sharpening stones are consumable items that adds an imbue to an Edged weapon that temporarily increases Weapon damage and some also increase Critical strike. Most are created with Blacksmithing. As of Patch 2.3, sharpening stones last 1 hour. As of Patch 3.0, sharpening stones can no longer be used on any weapon whose Item Level is higher than 165.

Sharptalon is a level 22 named blue hippogryph that roams the forests between Warsong Labor Camp and Splintertree Post in Ashenvale where he was hunted by the Horde as part of the Ashenvale Hunt. Some time after the invasion of Outland, Hamuul Runetotem gave a hippogryph feather to the gladiators Broll Bearmantle and Lo'Gosh. Broll used the feather to summon Sharptalon, and escape from Thunder Bluff to Ashenvale. During the process, Sharptalon was injured by an orc wyvern rider. Broll rode him during a fight in the Warsong Gulch. His next stops were Thistlefur Hold, Darnassus and Theramore and then Sharptalon was free to go. He apparently returned to Ashenvale as he was attacked and killed b
Sharptooth Frenzy are frenzies found in Northern Stranglethorn.

Shards of the Alliance is chapter 6 of the Terror of the Tides campaign. It was a series of small fights between members of the night elf expedition to Lordaeron led by Maiev and Tyrande and a small band of blood elves led by Kael against Scourge raiding parties.
Sharp Dagger is sold by several weapons vendors. It was previously a starting weapon for blood elf rogues; they also all wield a Sharp Dirk.

Sharptooth was the wolf companion of the Frostwolf clan chieftain Durotan on Azeroth. Sharptooth accompanied Durotan on his trip to warn Orgrim Doomhammer of the threat from Gul'dan and his Shadow Council. Sharptooth was killed by the same group of assassins who murdered both Durotan and Draka, and left their newborn child helpless in the forest.
The Shards of Myzrael is a big crystal shard northeast of the Circle of East Binding in the Arathi Highlands.
Sharpened Claws is a Feral druid talent focusing on Critical Strike.
Sharpened Fish Hooks have a chance to be in Bag of Fishing Treasures (Terokkar Forest) as a stack of 4-6.
The Sharkproof Boots were a quest reward from Preparing for the Worst during the Wrath of the Lich King beta.
Sharp Kitchen Knife is a quest reward from Westfall Stew (Classic 2).
__NOTOC__ Sharp-Barbed Leather Belt drops from Ingvar the Plunderer in Utgarde Keep on heroic mode.
Share The Love is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Gal'darah in Gundrak on Heroic difficulty and have 5 unique party members get impaled throughout the fight.
Sharpshooters (or sharp-shooters) are shooters of many races affiliated with various organizations. They use mostly guns, but bows and crossbows as well. They are hunter marksmen.

Shark Sinew dropped from Ravenous Threshers in Kelp'thar Forest.

Sharpening Sheathes come in varying sizes constructed for short swords, longswords, bastard swords and greatswords. When a sword is drawn from a sharpening sheath, miniature grindstones built into its housing sharpen the edge of the blade. As sharpening sheathes are thick and bulky, they are usually worn over the shoulder on a baldric rather than hanging from the belt.
Share the Pain is an achievement earned during the Baleroc encounter in the Firelands.

This rogue-only quest is the twelfth and penultimate part of the chain to obtain the legendary dagger set Fangs of the Father. It is the second and last quest in that chain to require multiple runs through the Dragon Soul raid.

Sharm is a Warcraft song writer and parodist. She has a charming British accent and used to play World of Warcraft. She is also known as Tainted Lore and her main is a human warlock.
